next_stage_plan.task_description: Conserve fuel while remaining outside the congested inner approach until the berth schedule is confirmed.
next_stage_plan.rationale: Reducing speed uses the waiting time productively without entering the constrained approach or consuming fuel at passage speed; the schedule can be reviewed before the next maneuver.

disruption.description: The terminal has postponed berth assignment while cargo operations at the facility are completed. The next berth slot is expected at 19:00 UTC, and the inner approach is congested.

operational_constraints: Remain outside the 12-nautical-mile approach limit until a berth slot is assigned.
Avoid joining the inner approach queue before the confirmed berth window.

candidate_actions.description: Reduce speed on the approved route and reassess the berth schedule after six hours.
Maintain position in the designated offshore waiting area while awaiting a berth assignment.
Advance at moderate speed to the outer approach waypoint while remaining outside the 12-nautical-mile limit.

replanning_trajectory.replanning_trigger: The terminal advised that berth assignment was delayed and the next slot was expected at 19:00 UTC.
replanning_trajectory.updated_state_summary: At 18.40°N, 120.72°E, the tanker is making 10.2 knots with 692.5 tonnes of fuel remaining and is outside the 12-nautical-mile approach limit.
replanning_trajectory.task_description: Reduce fuel use while staying clear of the congested inner approach and await a schedule update.
replanning_trajectory.action_description: Reduce speed to 7.5 knots along the approved route for six hours, then reassess the berth schedule.
replanning_trajectory.outcome_summary: After six hours the vessel remains outside the approach limit with an estimated 688.8 tonnes of fuel. The terminal confirms that the berth slot is not expected before 19:00 UTC.

replanning_trajectory.replanning_trigger: The terminal confirmed the delayed berth window, requiring the vessel to adjust its approach timing.
replanning_trajectory.updated_state_summary: At 12:00 UTC the tanker is making 7.5 knots, has approximately 688.8 tonnes of fuel remaining, and remains outside the 12-nautical-mile limit; the berth slot is expected at 19:00 UTC.
replanning_trajectory.task_description: Move toward the outer holding waypoint at a controlled speed without joining the inner approach queue early.
replanning_trajectory.action_description: Proceed toward the outer holding waypoint at 6.5 knots while maintaining the required stand-off distance.
replanning_trajectory.outcome_summary: The vessel reaches the outer holding waypoint at 16:00 UTC with an estimated 686.4 tonnes of fuel. It remains outside the inner approach, with the berth window still expected at 19:00 UTC.

next_stage_plan.task_description: Reach the designated lee holding area and remain clear of the exposed terminal approach until the gale eases.
next_stage_plan.rationale: Diverting to the holding area avoids the exposed approach while the winds remain above the vessel's operating limit, and preserves fuel for the onward passage.

disruption.description: A rapidly deepening gale is forecast across the exposed terminal approach. Sustained winds are above the vessel's approach limit, making entry unsafe until conditions ease.

operational_constraints: Do not enter the exposed terminal approach sector while sustained winds exceed the vessel's approach limit.
Reassess the weather forecast before leaving a sheltered holding area.

candidate_actions.description: Proceed at reduced speed to the designated lee holding area and reassess before approaching the terminal.
Maintain a safe position clear of the approach sector while awaiting the next forecast update.
Continue toward the exposed terminal approach at the current passage speed despite the gale conditions.

replanning_trajectory.replanning_trigger: The gale warning was upgraded, placing forecast winds above the terminal approach limit.
replanning_trajectory.updated_state_summary: At 54.18°N, 4.72°W, the tanker is making 9.4 knots with 824.6 tonnes of fuel remaining; the exposed approach is unsafe in the forecast conditions.
replanning_trajectory.task_description: Reach a sheltered holding area before reassessing the terminal approach.
replanning_trajectory.action_description: Divert toward Lee Holding Area L-2 at 7 knots.
replanning_trajectory.outcome_summary: After 5.5 hours the vessel reaches the holding area at reduced speed. The approach remains above its wind limit, so entry is deferred.

replanning_trajectory.replanning_trigger: The latest forecast continues to show unsafe approach conditions, while the vessel is now at the designated holding area.
replanning_trajectory.updated_state_summary: The tanker is maintaining a safe position at Lee Holding Area L-2 with approximately 820 tonnes of fuel remaining; gale conditions persist across the approach.
replanning_trajectory.task_description: Maintain the sheltered position and reassess conditions before resuming the approach.
replanning_trajectory.action_description: Hold position at Lee Holding Area L-2 and request another weather assessment in five hours.
replanning_trajectory.outcome_summary: By 16:30 UTC, forecast winds have fallen below the vessel's approach limit. The vessel remains outside the approach sector and is ready for a new short-horizon plan.
